access: Explicit positive column_width, no default. Concrete producer regenerates all1102 full six-block feature vectors for every requested block, authenticates original media/checkpoint/programme/runtime identities, verifies full row-value hashes on every repeated pass, charges16x1102 forwards and all native reads per pass. Baseline hashes commit only after complete first pass. No arbitrary feature callback or omitted coordinate.
centering: Each column uses the same float64 TRAIN-only mean/std and StandardScaler constant-feature scale=1; retain explicit PCA second TRAIN centering m. Every column contributes to G=sum_b Zb ZbT and query cross C=sum_b Qb ZbT after this second centering. Float64 ordered block accumulation; complete small TRAIN Gram spectrum through numpy2.2.6.linalg.eigh on the actual qualified BLAS/LAPACK build.
cutoff_policy: Select same strict95% k as authoritative fullSVD on the observed complete spectrum, but require outward interval certification: fraction at k has lower bound>0.95 and fraction at k-1 has upper bound<=0.95. Require lambda_k-lambda_(k+1)>2E at the boundary (unless k spans all resolved positive spectrum). If boundary/rank/ties are unresolved, refuse streamed case and require actual fullSVD comparison under separately sufficient resource capacity; never silently enlarge/shrink rank. Degenerate retained groups entirely inside the selected subspace may rotate without changing ridge predictions, but sign/basis rules and observed backend identity remain recorded.
eigensystem_bound: Use a posteriori reconstruction/orthogonality certification rather than assuming a LAPACK epsilon. With finite reported U,Lambda, outward-bound eta=||U^T U-I||_F and r=||Ghat-U Lambda U^T||_F including product-roundoff bounds. Require eta<1. Let d=eta/(1+sqrt(1-eta)), L=max(abs(lambda)); then E=GramFormationBound+r+d*L*(sqrt(1+eta)+1) is a conservative spectral eigenvalue-error bound via the polar orthogonal factor and Weyl. Every scalar bound is rounded outward. This proposed bound implementation itself requires independent mathematical/source review before qualified runtime.
equivalence_gate: Before scientific use, compare actual supported nested FIT/query transforms and downstream predictions against fullSVD under declared error envelopes and full support. No parity, competence, timing, numerical-precision or native-resource qualification claimed by source-only construction.
formation_bound: For every dot-product with k terms use conservative gamma_(2k)=2ku/(1-2ku), including an outward-rounded additive subnormal bound for each of the at most2k scalar operations. Absolute-product accumulation supplies a certified upper bound, with its own roundoff inflation. Include each block-add error and sum all entrywise bounds; Frobenius upper norm bounds Gram spectral formation error. Bound routines must perform outward rounding and refuse invalid2ku>=1 or nonfinite bounds.
roundoff_profile: A required observed arithmetic profile must establish IEEE754 binary64 round-to-nearest, gradual underflow, no overflow, no reduced-precision products, and actual pinned BLAS/LAPACK implementation. No source document boolean issues this qualification. Unit roundoff u=2^-53 and minimum positive subnormal=2^-1074 are format constants, not fitted epsilons.
scientific_identity: Same full17-node features, unique TRAIN-video StandardScaler and full PCA95; fullSVD retained as authoritative comparison implementation. Mathematical equivalence does not assert bitwise equivalence.
scores: For G=U diag(lambda) U^T, retained TRAIN scores=U sqrt(lambda); query scores=C U/sqrt(lambda). FullSVD selection uses strict cumulative explained variance >0.95 (right search). No randomized/incremental/truncated SVD, no feature pooling, no changed support.
spectrum_policy: Reject eigenvalues below -E. Values in[-E,E] are explicitly unresolved numerical null directions and may only be excluded if the selected retained subspace is provably separated and no cutoff depends on them. Never use a fixed epsilon, clip an eigenvalue below-E, or discard a resolved positive direction to meet resources. If total variance is not provably positive, case unavailable. Retained eigenvalues must exceed E for inverse-square-root scoring.
status: proposal awaiting exact root numeric selection; no numerical run
workspace_and_cost: Retain one complete pervideo vector set+actual frames, one1102xcolumn_width buffer, TRAIN/query Gram matrices, full small eigensystem and necessary final model states. Means/scales may be streamed/captured by column; aggregate retention and repeatedencoder costs bounded explicitly. Existing fullmaterialization remains an honest large-resource alternative; no feature bodies are generated in this source phase.
